subject: th-cont
title: TH.CONT-----C.INFO.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-41, on the page where Braxton names Charlie Parker's activity as 'the embodiment of the second transformation of black people in America' — the moment 'the affinity insight (1) principle' (the transformation/affirmation principle introduced two pages earlier) emerged after WWII through bebop's relation to what America calls 'art music'. (C)TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is crossed with C-INFO (composite information): the question is how the thrust continuance of black creativity gets organized into composite information when AFI(1) has just been activated — i.e., how is Charlie Parker's transformation legible as composite information? The diagram is unusually compact for vol1 — only 6 nodes — suggesting Braxton wants the structural claim crisp. (C)MT-INFO (the concept of multi-information) sits at the bend of the path from the subject: TH-CONT runs to MT-INFO, which branches to PRI-INFO (principle information) and runs on to C-INFO; C-INFO branches to RT-T and to MT-IF-DB (multi-informational degree basis). The structural argument: at the AFI(1) transformation moment, thrust continuance reaches composite information only through multi-information, which also reaches principle information directly. The diagram is thus Braxton's specification of why bebop is structurally consequential: it puts multi-information into the *generative* position from which composite information, and through it RT-T and the degree-basis of further multi-information, derive.
